source.author: muser
source.notes: Vital is an open-source (GPL) spectral-warping wavetable synth: 3 wavetable oscillators, a sample/noise oscillator, 2 filters, 6 envelopes, 8 LFOs, a 64-slot modulation matrix and built-in effects (chorus, compressor, delay, distortion, EQ, flanger, phaser, reverb). It has 2852 parameters; the ones below are what you need for most sounds. Use the VST3 build as an instrument: "instrument": "plugin:/usr/lib/vst3/Vital.vst3". The init sound is a plain saw, unfiltered, 8 voices, Volume -6 dB. Wavetables and the modulation matrix are not parameters: muser sets them with the reserved keys @wavetable and @modulations (see Tips).

params.name: Oscillator 1 Wave Frame
params.description: Position in oscillator 1's wavetable, 0–256. Only matters for multi-frame tables (@wavetable basic / pwm / harmonics / formant); a good target for automation or @modulations (osc_1_wave_frame)

params.name: Oscillator 1 Unison Voices
params.description: Number of stacked, detuned copies of oscillator 1. 1v = plain; 3–5v = thick; 7–16v = supersaw

params.name: Oscillator 1 Unison Detune
params.description: Spread of the unison voices. 10–20 % subtle, 30–50 % wide supersaw

params.name: Oscillator 1 Stereo Spread
params.description: Stereo width of the unison voices (default 100 %); lower it for basses

params.name: Oscillator 1 Transpose
params.description: Semitones (-48 … 48). -12 = one octave down

params.name: Oscillator 1 Level
params.description: Oscillator 1 volume (0–1, default 0.5)

params.name: Oscillator 1 Stack Style
params.description: How unison voices are tuned: Unison (detuned), Octave, Power Chord, Major / Minor Chord, Harmonics…

params.name: Oscillator 1 Distortion Type
params.description: Phase distortion of the oscillator (Vital's 'warp'): Sync, Formant, Bend, Squeeze, Pulse, FM / RM from another oscillator

params.name: Oscillator 1 Distortion Amount
params.description: Amount of the warp (default 50 %)

params.name: Oscillator 2 Switch
params.description: Turns oscillator 2 on (default Off). Then set osc2_transpose / osc2_level, and its wavetable with @wavetable {"2": …}

params.name: Oscillator 2 Transpose
params.description: Semitones; -12 for a sub octave, 7 for a fifth, 12 for an octave up

params.name: Oscillator 2 Tune
params.description: Fine tune of oscillator 2; a small offset (0.05–0.1) against oscillator 1 gives beating / thickness

params.name: Oscillator 2 Level
params.description: Oscillator 2 volume (0–1)

params.name: Filter 1 Switch
params.description: Turns filter 1 on (default Off — the init sound is unfiltered). Oscillators 1 and 2 feed filter 1 by default

params.name: Filter 1 Model
params.description: Filter character. Analog = clean, Dirty = driven, Ladder = Moog-like, Digital, Diode = acid, Formant = vowels, Comb, Phaser

params.name: Filter 1 Style
params.description: Slope / mode of the model: 12dB, 24dB, Notch Blend, Notch Spread, B/P/N

params.name: Filter 1 Cutoff
params.description: Cutoff in semitones relative to middle C (MIDI 60 ≈ 262 Hz), -52 … +76. -24 ≈ 65 Hz, -12 ≈ 131 Hz, 0 ≈ 262 Hz, 12 ≈ 523 Hz, 24 ≈ 1 kHz, 36 ≈ 2.1 kHz, 48 ≈ 4.2 kHz, 60 ≈ 8.4 kHz

params.name: Filter 1 Resonance
params.description: Resonance (default 50 % — quite high; 10–30 % for a smooth filter)

params.name: Filter 1 Drive
params.description: Drive into the filter (0–20 dB)

params.name: Filter 1 Key Track
params.description: How much the cutoff follows the note (default 0 %); 50–100 % keeps high notes as bright as low ones

params.name: Filter 1 FILTER Input
params.description: Whether filter 1 receives the other filter's output. Leave Off unless chaining filters

params.name: Envelope 1 Attack
params.description: Amplitude envelope (Envelope 1 drives the volume)

params.name: Envelope 1 Sustain
params.description: 0–1; 0 for plucks and keys that die away

params.name: Envelope 1 Release
params.description: Default 0.09 s — short. 0.3–1 s for keys, 1–3 s for pads

params.name: Envelope 2 Attack
params.description: Envelope 2 does nothing until routed with @modulations (source env_2), e.g. to filter_1_cutoff

params.name: Envelope 2 Decay
params.description: Length of the filter 'blip' when env_2 → filter_1_cutoff: 0.1–0.3 s pluck / bass, 1 s+ slow sweep

params.name: Envelope 2 Sustain
params.description: 0 for a filter that closes back after the blip

params.name: LFO 1 Tempo
params.description: LFO 1 speed in note values when LFO 1 Sync is Tempo (default, follows the project tempo). 1/8 = wobble, 1/1–4/1 = slow movement

params.name: LFO 1 Sync
params.description: Tempo (default), Tempo Dotted, Tempo Triplets, Seconds (then LFO 1 Frequency), Keytrack

params.name: Modulation 1 Amount
params.description: Amount of the first @modulations entry (-1 … 1). Modulation 2 Amount … for the next ones. Automatable: e.g. a filter envelope that gets deeper over the song

params.name: Polyphony
params.description: Voices (default 8). 1 voices + Legato On for mono basses and leads

params.name: Legato
params.description: With Polyphony 1: overlapping notes don't retrigger the envelopes

params.name: Portamento Time
params.description: Glide time between notes (default ≈ 0)

params.name: Velocity Track
params.description: How much note velocity changes the volume (default 0 % — all notes equally loud)

params.name: Volume
params.description: Master volume, default -6.02dB. Leave headroom: multi-voice unison patches get loud

params.name: Reverb Switch
params.description: Built-in reverb on/off; then Reverb Mix, Reverb Decay Time, Reverb Size

params.name: Delay Switch
params.description: Built-in delay on/off; follows the project tempo (Delay Tempo, default 1/8)

params.name: Chorus Switch
params.description: Built-in chorus on/off (wide, quite strong at its default 50 % mix)

params.name: Distortion Switch
params.description: Built-in distortion on/off; Distortion Type, Distortion Drive

params.name: Macro 1
params.description: Macro knob 1 (0–1); does nothing until routed with @modulations (source macro_control_1). Route one macro to several destinations, then automate the macro

presets.name: bass
presets.description: Saw + square sub octave through a 24 dB ladder; a short filter envelope 'blip' on every note; mono legato

presets.name: sub
presets.description: Pure sine one octave down, mono: sub bass under a busier bass or kick

presets.name: reese
presets.description: Detuned 4-voice saw, lightly filtered and driven: drum & bass / dubstep reese

presets.name: supersaw
presets.description: 9-voice detuned saw plus a 5-voice octave above, open filter, a little reverb: trance / EDM lead or chords

presets.name: pad
presets.description: Morphing wavetable (sine→triangle) slowly moved by LFO 1, 6 unison voices, slow attack, chorus and long reverb

presets.name: pluck
presets.description: Filter envelope pluck: short decay, no sustain, 1/8 tempo delay and reverb

presets.name: wobble
presets.description: Dirty resonant filter wobbling at 1/8 notes (LFO 1, tempo-synced), square sub, distortion: dubstep

presets.name: pwm_lead
presets.description: Pulse-width-modulated lead (pwm wavetable swept by LFO 1), mono with glide, a touch of delay

presets.name: keys
presets.description: Harmonic wavetable that darkens as the note decays (env_2 → frame), velocity → brightness, chorus: soft synth keys

tips: @wavetable picks the oscillator wavetable: "@wavetable": "basic" (all three oscillators) or {"1": "basic", "2": "square"}. Built-in tables: saw (init), sine, triangle, square, basic (sine → triangle → saw → square at Wave Frame 0 / 85 / 170 / 256), pwm (pulse narrowing across frames), harmonics (sine → 16 harmonics), formant (vocal / sync-like). Frames of multi-frame tables are chosen with `frame` (Oscillator 1 Wave Frame).

@modulations wires the modulation matrix: [{"source": "env_2", "destination": "filter_1_cutoff", "amount": 0.5}, …] (up to 64; amount -1 … 1, optional "bipolar": true). It replaces the whole matrix. Without it, envelopes 2–6, LFOs, macros and velocity do nothing.
Modulation sources: env_1 … env_6, lfo_1 … lfo_8, random_1 … random_4, macro_control_1 … macro_control_4, velocity, note, aftertouch, mod_wheel, pitch_wheel.

Modulation destinations are Vital's internal names: filter_1_cutoff, filter_1_resonance, filter_1_drive, osc_1_wave_frame, osc_1_level, osc_1_pan, osc_1_tune, osc_1_unison_detune, osc_1_distortion_amount, osc_2_… (same for oscillator 2), volume, reverb_dry_wet, delay_dry_wet, chorus_dry_wet, distortion_drive. A wrong name is rejected with similar names.

Modulation amounts are fractions of the destination's whole range: for filter_1_cutoff (128 semitones) 0.25 ≈ +32 semitones (two and a half octaves), 0.5 ≈ +64. Start at 0.3–0.6 with the cutoff set low.
Filter 1 is Off in the init patch: set "filter": "On" first, otherwise cutoff / resonance do nothing. Its default resonance is 50 %, quite peaky.
LFOs, the delay and other tempo-synced features follow the project tempo (muser sends it to the plugin).

Continuous parameters take the displayed text: "0.5 secs", "-12 semitones", "30%", "-6dB", "7v". Plain numbers are on the plugin's 0–1 scale, which is non-linear for times and cutoff — prefer the text.
For mono basses and leads: polyphony "1 voices" and legato "On"; add glide for slides.
Unison patches get loud and wide quickly; lower `volume` and use `spread` 30–60 % on basses so the low end stays mono.
Any parameter can be automated by name or alias, e.g. frame, cutoff, Modulation 1 Amount, Macro 1.
